title: Catch a throwing sweep-list loader and convert it to the AC19 `unreadable` degraded record
text: Catch a throwing sweep-list loader and convert it to the AC19 `unreadable` degraded record. It currently escapes to the shared failure path, failing the review instead of continuing as an ordinary non-sweep pass; the required thrown-loader unreadable regression case is also missing.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 69a0e66, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
